name: honorbox
description: Sell digital products with just Stripe + GitHub. An open source Gumroad alternative: no platform fee, no monthly cost, no server. Private repo delivery: after payment each buyer is granted collaborator access to your private repository, re-invited before GitHub expires the invitation.

paragraphs: Sell digital products with just Stripe + GitHub. No platform, no monthly fee, no server.
HonorBox turns a GitHub repo into an unattended store, a roadside honor box for the internet:

hosted free on GitHub Pages. No framework, no build step you have to run, and nothing loaded from anyone else's server: zero external scripts, styles, fonts or images. The only scripts on a built page are first party and inline, about 5 KB unminified and mostly comments: the JSON-LD block search engines read, plus a theme toggle and a scroll reveal. Both degrade to a fully readable page with JavaScript switched off.

requirements.text: If you take the money on your own Stripe account and add each buyer as a collaborator by hand, or with glue you wrote, the fulfillment bullet above is the part you are doing manually, and it runs without the rest: scripts/fulfill.js reads one config file mapping each payment link to the repo it grants, and needs no theme, no products/ directory and no site.
Most of its checks fire with zero orders in your account, which is when you need them.
